location.climate: Four seasons, cold winters (-3°C to 5°C), warm summers (22-30°C)

english_proficiency.waiver_conditions: Primary language English or 4+ years in English-medium school

academic_programs.curriculum_structure: Distribution requirements + Major concentration + Independent work

korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: Limited in Princeton - Korean restaurants in nearby Edison (25 min), Fort Lee area (1 hour)
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Korean churches in Edison/Piscataway area (25-30 min)

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Strong independent thinkers, research-oriented, genuine intellectual curiosity

korean_specific_advice: Princeton emphasizes independent work - show ability to drive your own projects
Senior thesis tradition means research experience valued highly
Smaller, more close-knit community - show you'd thrive in intimate setting
Honor code culture important - demonstrate integrity
SCEA (Single Choice Early Action) - must be top choice if applying early
Beautiful campus life - show appreciation for traditional college experience
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Not demonstrating fit with Princeton's independent work focus
Essays too focused on achievements rather than intellectual journey
Not showing why suburban campus environment appeals to you
Applying SCEA without Princeton being genuine first choice

campus_life.dining_options: Residential college dining halls, eating clubs for upperclassmen
campus_life.safety_rating: Very high - small town, Campus Public Safety
campus_life.nearby_attractions: NYC (1 hour), Philadelphia (1 hour), Campus museums

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Active Princeton Korean Alumni group with focus on academia and finance
